requirement: Drawing engine independent of the costing engine; both meet in a Unified Engineering Data Layer before costing
evidence: Offline path: reader → consolidate → replayReview → answersFromEngineeringData (drawing-context.ts:137-155). But the AI path still reads the PDF itself and writes surfaceTreatment / gear reads that reach the form (cad.ts:1206,1276; main.ts:14189-14226).
notes: Findings F01, F02.

requirement: Completely offline; zero external AI/LLM/cloud calls; drawings never uploaded
evidence: Reader path itself is offline (see C05-C07). But with mode 'ai'/'both' + key, or an API call with no mode on an unruled commodity + server key, a PDF drawing is sent base64 to Anthropic (cad.ts:817, 1206, 1276-1281, 1286-1306) while the UI states 'Read on this server — no AI, nothing leaves it' (drawing-review.ts:22, main.ts:5818).
notes: Default UI mode is 'deterministic' and is always sent explicitly (main.ts:6591-6592), so the default flow does not upload. Finding F01 (Critical).

requirement: Deterministic algorithms, OCR, CV, rules; no local ML models without approval
evidence: Regex grammars (extract/*.ts), ISO 286 table (data/iso286.ts), Otsu/skew (raster/preprocess.ts), Tesseract 5 LSTM via tesseract.js-core (raster/ocr.ts:1-15).
notes: Tesseract's LSTM recogniser is itself a neural model; the brief names Tesseract as acceptable traditional OCR.

requirement: No runtime network dependency: OCR engine and language data
evidence: ocr.ts requires tesseract.js-core (WASM) and reads @tesseract.js-data/<lang> or CV_TESSDATA_DIR from disk (ocr.ts:16-29,138-156); tesseract.js (CDN default) not in package.json and not imported (grep). Both eng and deu data installed (ls node_modules/@tesseract.js-data).
notes: CLI OCR run on gen-casting.scan200.pdf completed locally in 19 s (12.8 s OCR).

requirement: No runtime network: pdfjs worker, CMaps, standard fonts
evidence: pdfjs.ts:31-50: legacy build from node_modules, standardFontDataUrl / cMapUrl / wasmUrl / iccUrl are local paths, disableAutoFetch/Range/Stream, useSystemFonts false, isEvalSupported false.
